_readme: MULTIPLAYER_PLAN_V6 (2026-11-15): every number for parties, bots, voting and difficulty by team size. Read by scripts/autoload/Party.gd and Net.gd. Words are in story.json "party". relay_url = the internet relay (must start with wss:// for the web build on https). While it says PLACEHOLDER the game uses local_relay_url (a relay running on this computer: serve_relay.ps1).
relay_url: PLACEHOLDER: the coach fills this in. It starts with wss://
_ready_readme: Ready checks (DEFAULT): a screen moves on when every human is ready. After ready_go_anyway_seconds the party leader gets a quiet 'Go anyway' button.
_score_wait_readme: Minigames (DEFAULT, the plan said 15 s after time is up): once the party leader has a score, a player who has not sent theirs within score_wait_seconds gets 0, so nobody waits forever. Each new score that arrives starts the wait again.

scaling._readme: Harder with more players (bots count as players). ship_problems = how many times the ship's emergencies; supply_drain = how much faster the life bars and crew supplies go down; data_goal = how many times the data target. The first two columns are Holden's numbers; data_goal is a DEFAULT.
scaling.source: Game-design choice (Holden's note, 2026-11-15). Amy playtests and tunes it.

bots._readme: What bots do. minigame scores: a random whole number from min to max, new for each minigame (Holden). A bot takes a ship problem nobody has started after take_problem_after_seconds and fixes it in fix_problem_in_seconds (DEFAULT). data_share_min/max = each bot gathers this share of one player's data target during the flight, at a steady pace (DEFAULT, same 85-100% as the minigames).

code._readme: Party codes: length letters from letters (no vowels and no look-alike letters, so a code cannot spell a word). The relay makes the codes.

debug._readme: Testing with bots on one computer (MULTIPLAYER_PLAN_V6 A4/A5): fake_vote_key casts a fake human vote in a vote, or flips a fake human's GO / NO-GO on the launch pad. It only works in a bots party.
